task: Add a 'Download all files' action to the Agent Workspace UI that calls the existing backend archive endpoint and surfaces its 400/413/500 and partial-skip-header outcomes.

key_reasoning.reason: The single-file download/blob-stream pattern (api.downloadFileStream + agentWorkspaceStore.downloadSelectedFile) is an exact precedent, but the backend's three distinct failure modes (400 empty/forbidden, 413 over-cap, 500 unreadable) plus the non-fatal X-Workspace-Skipped-Count partial-failure header are new behavior with no existing frontend test template — AC #10 explicitly requires coverage for these cases.

Two components across two layers: a new agentWorkspaceStore action/flag (store layer) and a new Button in AgentWorkspaceBrowserPopup.tsx (component layer); pattern is clear from downloadSelectedFile/isDownloading.

ACs are concretely enumerated, but the tech analysis flags open design decisions: whether to surface per-status-code messaging (400 vs 413 vs 500) distinctly, and where to add X-Workspace-Skipped-Count header-reading (shared downloadFileStream helper vs. new store-level logic).

red_flags_applied: Technical Risk bumped from M to L: ACs enumerate specific error/edge cases (400 empty/forbidden, 413 over-cap, 500 unreadable, partial-skip header) and no existing frontend test template covers this defensive pattern (per Testing Landscape § Coverage Gaps in technical-analysis.md).
